summary: Line crosses the Centenary Motorway; no stopping anywhere and no room to pull off.

drivers.seclusion: Nothing usable; the stretch is a motorway crossing with a house at the west end.
drivers.access_and_room: No pull-off: kerb meets motorway lanes or steep bush, with no clear ground beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Heavy motorway traffic across the whole stretch.
drivers.convention: No cars parked; three No Stopping Any Time signs nearby.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at the motorway
Low-lying: about 5 m, creek 13 m away
sun_shade: Mixed: bush shades the east end, the west is open road.
